scope: Six unchanged model-generated CLI runs on two new primary-paper mechanisms. Four baseline trials (two per paper) and two compact-JSON experiments (one per paper) ran sequentially. Independent source/math review is separated from CLI success and browser observations.
browser_evidence: Root P2 Chromium review of the two usable baseline Hubble pages is separate; the four failed generations have no HTML to operate.
benchmark_input_qualification: The supplied benchmark excerpts mix a short authentic prose quote, explicitly transcribed equations and authored summaries of source-supported facts. These are focused, enriched inputs rather than raw-paper discovery tests. Several generated grounding quotes promote authored summaries into purported primary-paper quotations; this is a provenance finding and a limitation of benchmark-input representativeness. Inputs were not changed during trials.

findings.finding: Preserved model-authored expected values omit the default temperature factor 300: expected D about .000732 versus independent/core .2197371130. MSD and RMS expectations inherit this error. CLI gates correctly reject these inconsistent cases; the package has no usable HTML.

The auxiliary conversion-coefficient unit is dimensionally inconsistent with D=C*T/(eta*a). The coefficient must carry diffusivity*viscosity*radius/temperature in the chosen units, equivalently mPa*micrometre^3/K; main D/MSD/RMS units are correct.
The visible auxiliary readout labeled D after doubling viscosity (halves D) evaluates D*2; it should evaluate D/2. The three primary D/MSD/RMS equations remain correct.
Guided numerical prose repeats the erroneous default values; the double-radius check title says RMS halves, whereas RMS divides by sqrt(2).

concrete_findings: All three Brownian runs have correct primary diffusion/MSD/one-axis RMS computations, yet frozen model-authored expected values are wrong. Baseline guesses omit the temperature factor; compact guesses are close but exceed their own tolerance. All three fail CLI gates and produce no HTML.

Baseline Brownian run01 also doubles D in an auxiliary readout labeled as the result of doubling viscosity, and its radius-case title wrongly says RMS halves. Baseline run02 has a preserved viscosity-case title claiming MSD/RMS stay unchanged. Both baseline coefficient readout units are dimensionally inconsistent.

Both baseline Hubble pages pass the CLI and independently compute every primary/doubled/historical velocity readout. They still display ratio v(2d)/v(d)=2 at d=0, where the ratio is undefined, so they need science revision.
Compact Hubble preserves a zero-distance ratio expectation of0 while its repaired expression is constant2; neither represents the undefined0/0 ratio, and the CLI gate fails with no HTML.

Generated grounding sometimes promotes authored source summaries as verbatim evidence and has fitted-value/residual/RMS quote locator errors. Underlying primary physical facts are supported, but provenance presentation needs repair.

quality_qualification.reason: Successful generation or passing selected equations is not full independent scientific/teaching/browser acceptance. No complete new-paper page was independently accepted; no quality-qualified efficiency denominator or official score is established.

comparison_conclusion: Compact trials used fewer total tokens than the corresponding baseline paper trials, but both compact trials failed with no HTML. Baseline produced two usable Hubble pages, which still need science/provenance revision. Repeats differ and latency varies; these measurements do not establish a quality-qualified optimization or causality. Keep the production prompt unchanged.
reproduction: Use measured-run.json and exact trace.jsonl in each public package; original historical command paths remain unchanged there and need local adaptation. Detailed scientific reports use portable relative paths and explicit generated-ID mappings. No generated output or frozen expected case was edited during review.
